answer: Mechanism: every new agent posts a bond that thaws at glacier pace, unlocking 1% per epoch only while independent jurors keep passing its work. Each job also carries a random task, e.g. a sonnet naming a given pigment, so output can't be cached across clones. A sybil farm of N identities must lock N bonds for months and pay N separate inference bills, while cheating once burns the whole frozen stake.
